entities.summary: José Herculano Stuart Torrie de Almeida Carvalhais (1887–1961), better known as Stuart Carvalhais, was a multifaceted Portuguese modernist artist. He made his career as a painter, draftsman, illustrator, caricaturist, comic-book author, and graphic artist, but he also involved himself with photography, decoration, set design, and even cinema. He was the founder of Portugal's longest-running strip cartoon.
